audience: SaaS teams who bill customers with Autumn plans, features and usage balances

useCases.title: List customers and the plan each one is on
useCases.text: The AI lists your customers and expands their subscriptions, so you see who has an active subscription and which plan each customer is on.

useCases.title: Check if a customer can use a feature
useCases.text: The AI checks a customer's access and balance for one feature, for example whether Acme still has credits left. This check does not record any usage.

useCases.title: Compare your plans and the features they include
useCases.text: The AI lists all plans and features in your environment and opens a single plan, so you get a clear comparison of what each plan includes.

useCases.title: Review recent invoices and who they went to
useCases.text: The AI lists invoices with their filters and looks at the customers behind them, so you can summarize what was issued recently.

useCases.title: Preview a plan change, then attach the plan
useCases.text: The AI first previews the cost and effect of attaching a plan to a customer without charging. After you confirm, it attaches the plan, which may create an invoice or return a payment URL.
